pending.title: Mural street portrait
pending.prompt: A realistic vertical street portrait of the person in the photo sitting casually on the pavement. They have mid-length wavy brown hair, wearing an open loose beige shirt over a white top and blue denim jeans. Directly behind them on a distressed, weathered concrete wall is a large artistic mural featuring an oversized close-up portrait of the exact same person's face, blending into the painted texture of the wall. Warm sunset golden-hour lighting, cinematic depth of field, natural skin texture, and a raw photographic style. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged. Use a [LIGHTING_STYLE: warm golden hour] look.
